title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
build: Two G64 disk sides (with three more copies of side 2 that hold other saved games): side 1 boots FREDDY, a 1-block file that loads MAIN.OBJ, which loads the resident loader, the sound effects, the fast loader and the street part INIT at $1390; side 2 holds the house part MAIN at $1390 and the ten levels' maps, objects, and art
